methodology.scope: All local GLBs under public/models/characters, public/models/vehicles and public/models/heroes-generated, plus catalog-selected/optional paths.
methodology.logicalTextureEstimate: RGBA8 width × height × 4 bytes, plus an exact complete 2D mip chain down to 1×1. This is an image-inventory comparison, NOT measured browser residency, decoded heap, driver allocations or VRAM.
methodology.duplicateDefinition: SHA-256 of identical encoded image payload bytes. Different encodings of identical pixels are not deduplicated; no pixels are decoded.
methodology.totalsCaution: Inventory groups overlap and are not all loaded simultaneously. Image entries include unused/fallback alternatives; referenced counts are provided separately. Sampler behavior, channels/formats, compressed GPU textures, image/texture clones, render targets and alignment change actual residency.
methodology.sourceProfiles: Per-asset defaultSources and preferWebP choose one image candidate per material-referenced texture definition, collapsing shared image indices. They are conditional metadata views, not loaded-image measurements; unresolvedTextures marks candidates with no compatible source. Material references include definitions whether or not the resulting mesh is visible. KTX2/Basis alternatives are inventoried separately, not assumed supported.
methodology.selection: Garment selections reproduce wardrobeGarmentModelUrl using the production availability/revision guards. Portrait means compact preview (component width ≤960), not a platform-wide mobile toggle. Bundles/corsets report available candidate tiers; runtime rig-fit fallback is not simulated.
methodology.noMutation: No runtime sources, GLBs, textures, exports or cache policies are modified. No remote image URI is fetched.
